title: RADDE January 15 peaceful demonstration and later arrests
location: Djibouti; exact assembly site unresolved. Djibouti City is campaign-level context, not proof of this venue.
participants_original: No attendance estimate recovered for this gathering or lead.
threshold_50_evidence: Unresolved: no numeric or sufficiently clear qualitative evidence of at least 50 actual participants. Arrests, weeks, campaign support and other events are not crowd counts.

start_date.summary: LDDH and USDOS explicitly identify January 15 demonstration.

location.summary: LDDH gives detention locations, not an exact gathering venue; CrisisWatch locates the broader RADDE series in Djibouti City. No Balbala protest venue inferred.

demands.summary: RADDE series is directed against Guelleh seeking a fifth term. This links the dated action to a political-process campaign, pending episode review.

protester_violence.summary: Contemporary LDDH explicitly describes the January 15 action as peaceful.

state_response.arrests.summary: Two January 15 participants/organizers were arrested in connection with the demonstration; USDOS later says released February 3.

end_date.summary: February 3 release concerns custody and does not establish the assembly end. No physical closure established.

notes: Repeated RADDE weeks may represent separate actions or a broader campaign; no automatic merging or splitting.
Police shooting of Ismail Houssein Waberi and relatives detained elsewhere are separate incidents in the source; not coded as responses here.
All state responses other than specifically documented arrests remain unknown.
open_questions: Separate gathering identity and campaign start/earlier Friday actions?
Physical assembly closure and other specific responses?
